properties.description: Pins propagate_from's arriving_from through the served tool. A member that uses the changed design takes the ripple across its interface (arrived, arrived_via across, its consumer reached) and does not send it back. A design with no recorded way in replies arrived: false and walks nothing. Seeds plus arriving_from, or neither, is refused. A row for an interface a uses pin names carries the member's design, and continue_in points across into it.
